```{r}
library(Seurat)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
Sample1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Sample1, project = "Sample1", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
Sample2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Sample2, project = "Sample2", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
Sample3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Sample3, project = "Sample3", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
Sample4 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Sample4, project = "Sample4", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
Sample5 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Sample5, project = "Sample5", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```

```{r}
Sample1[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Sample1, pattern ="^MT-")
Sample2[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Sample2, pattern ="^MT-")
Sample3[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Sample3, pattern ="^MT-")
Sample4[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Sample4, pattern ="^MT-")
Sample5[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Sample5, pattern ="^MT-")
```

```{r}
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(Sample1, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(Sample1, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
ggsave("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/SRP349751/Visualizations/QC/Sample1_qc.pdf")
```

```{r}
Sample1 <- subset(Sample1, subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 &
                          nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & percent.mt < 10)

Sample2 <- subset(Sample2, subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 &
                          nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & percent.mt < 10)

Sample3 <- subset(Sample3, subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 &
                          nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & percent.mt < 10)

Sample4 <- subset(Sample4, subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 &
                          nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & percent.mt < 10)

Sample5 <- subset(Sample5, subset = nFeature_RNA > 250 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 &
```

###Merge objects
```{r}
SRP349751_CEuE <- merge(Sample1, y=c(Sample2, Sample3, Sample4, Sample5), add.cell.ids = c("Sample1","Sample2","Sample3","Sample4","Sample5"))
```

Sample 1
```{r}
# Get the expression matrix (log-normalized data)
expr_data <- GetAssayData(Sample1, slot = "counts")


# Check which cells express ESR1 and/or ESR2
esr1_expr <- expr_data["ESR1", ] > 0
esr2_expr <- expr_data["ESR2", ] > 0

# Boolean logic to define each group
both     <- esr1_expr & esr2_expr
esr1_only <- esr1_expr & !esr2_expr
esr2_only <- !esr1_expr & esr2_expr
neither  <- !esr1_expr & !esr2_expr

# Count cells in each group
counts <- list(
  ESR1_only = sum(esr1_only),
  ESR2_only = sum(esr2_only),
  Both      = sum(both),
  Neither   = sum(neither)
)

print(counts)

```
